taskSpec.name: users-api
taskSpec.brief:
Build a Users REST API. The scaffold (problem+json errors, cursor pagination,
idempotency middleware, app wiring) is in place; implement the users resource:
Zod schemas in src/schemas/users.ts, an in-memory store in src/store/users.ts,
the router in src/routes/users.ts, and Vitest + supertest tests in tests/users.test.ts.

fields.name: string 1-100 chars, required
fields.role: one of admin | member | viewer, default member

behaviours: POST /v1/users creates a user -> 201; duplicate email -> 409 problem; invalid body -> 422 problem
GET /v1/users lists users with cursor pagination (limit 1-100, default 20) and optional role filter
GET /v1/users/:id returns a user -> 200; unknown id -> 404 problem; malformed id -> 422 problem
PATCH /v1/users/:id partially updates name/role/email -> 200; email clash -> 409
POST and PATCH honour Idempotency-Key (same key + same body replays the first response)
